title: Method C Framework Improvements Phase 1(d): Hold-Force Drop Numerical Investigation and Hypothesis Test
review_directive: Phase 1(d) Complete: Conclusively disproved the hypothesis that Gauss-point history averaging caused the -27.68% hold-force drop in Fix 1/2. Controlled Abaqus 2024 same-mesh simulation comparison at Cycle 48 (u2 = 0.2894 mm) demonstrates: Case A (exact per-GP transfer) reproduces donor RF2 to machine precision (-0.00036% jump, 2 iterations, Exit 0); Case B (element-averaged history) causes minor stiffening of +0.3666% (2 iterations, Exit 0, passing the <= 5.0% gate). Averaging effect (+0.37%) is 75x smaller than the Fix 1 drop and of opposite sign. The -27.68% drop in Fix 1 is physically explained by coarse-mesh stiffness locking in the donor mesh (h = 2.0 mm ~ 7 * l0) artificially elevating donor force, which relaxes when refined to h_ref = 0.140 mm (< l0/2). Resolved GAP-P1C-01 and GAP-P1C-02. 22/22 unit tests pass across Phases 1(a)-1(d); 0 PBS consumed (cumulative 73); frozen UEL CE8D5EDC preserved.
